steps.speaker: Faint Voice
steps.content: Hamel... Must protect Hamel... We can't let the human hurt Hamel...
You want to fan away what's blocking you, but find yourself passing through it directly. You can't hurt it, but it can't touch you either.
The Dancer at the center of the lake is still twirling, her body radiating a glimmer of light, protecting those illusions.
She doesn't answer, nor does she stop dancing.
You walk toward the center of the lake alone, pass through the white illusions, and arrive before Hamel.
Up close, she looks more mature than the woman in the picture. She's gentle, quiet, free of hostility, and indifferent to your arrival.
Your hand touches her and the shackles are activated, yet your hand only passes through her body, the red light shining onto void.
Hamel doesn't answer. The hem of her dress brushes against you, surprisingly removing all weariness from you.
The black Hamel was an illusion, and the Hamel before you is an illusion too. Has the shackles' guidance been wrong? Where is the real her? Where's the owner of the Black Ring?
Give up, you can't disturb her.
Behind you, another unseen puppet emerges. Just as you're about to resist, it raises its hand slightly, and the Sinners' illusions shielding you vanish.
They're merely illusions of your longing formed at the center of the illusory realm, they're not your companions.
This is her stage. We love her deeply and we protect her. On your own, you can't defeat Hamel.
